#@FILE path=js/charts.js enc=utf8 bytes=4534 sha256=60c6a8b1ee61019a4ef1b304f87239b6489b7b8ecfa0d1960c65f8ba3ac59af3
// Tiny SVG chart renderer (no library). Returns an SVG string sized by viewBox → scales to container width.
const W = 340, H = 150, PL = 30, PR = 8, PT = 10, PB = 22;
const f1 = x => Math.round(x * 10) / 10;
const niceStep = x => { const e = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(x))), m = x / e; return (m <= 1 ? 1 : m <= 2 ? 2 : m <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : m <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * e; };

/**
 * opt: { labels: [..], yMin, yMax, invert, yFmt, bars: [{values, color}] (stacked), barLine: {values,color} (drawn as tick per bar),
 *        lines: [{values, color, dash, dots}], band: [lo, hi, color], refLine: {y, color}, highlight: index, dots: [{i, y, color}] }
 */
export function chart(opt) {
  const n = opt.labels.length; if (!n) return '';
  const vals = [];
  (opt.bars || []).length && opt.labels.forEach((_, i) => vals.push(opt.bars.reduce((t, b) => t + (b.values[i] || 0), 0)));
  for (const l of opt.lines || []) vals.push(...l.values.filter(v => v != null));
  if (opt.barLine) vals.push(...opt.barLine.values.filter(v => v != null));
  for (const d of opt.dots || []) vals.push(d.y);
  let lo = opt.yMin ?? Math.min(0, ...vals), hi = opt.yMax ?? Math.max(1, ...vals);
  if (opt.yMin == null && opt.invert) lo = Math.min(...vals);
  if (opt.band) { lo = Math.min(lo, opt.band[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, opt.band[1]); }
  if (hi === lo) hi = lo + 1;
  if (opt.yMin == null && opt.invert) { const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.08 || 0.1; lo -= pad; hi += pad; }
  else if (opt.yMax == null) { const st = niceStep((hi - lo) * 1.05 / 3); hi = lo + 3 * st; }   // round axis: 3 even steps
  const iw = W - PL - PR, ih = H - PT - PB, bw = iw / n;
  const X = i => PL + bw * (i + 0.5);
  const Y = v => opt.invert ? PT + ih * (v - lo) / (hi - lo) : PT + ih * (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo));
  const fmt = opt.yFmt || (v => f1(v));
  const s = [`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="chart" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">`];
  // grid + y labels (4 ticks)
  const nt = opt.ticks || 3;
  for (let k = 0; k <= nt; k++) {
    const v = lo + (hi - lo) * k / nt, y = Y(v);
    s.push(`<line x1="${PL}" x2="${W - PR}" y1="${f1(y)}" y2="${f1(y)}" class="g"/><text x="${PL - 4}" y="${f1(y + 3)}" class="yl">${fmt(v)}</text>`);
  }
  if (opt.band) s.push(`<rect x="${PL}" width="${iw}" y="${f1(Math.min(Y(opt.band[0]), Y(opt.band[1])))}" height="${f1(Math.abs(Y(opt.band[1]) - Y(opt.band[0])))}" fill="${opt.band[2]}" opacity=".15"/>`);
  if (opt.highlight != null) s.push(`<rect x="${f1(PL + bw * opt.highlight)}" width="${f1(bw)}" y="${PT}" height="${ih}" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".05"/>`);
  // stacked bars
  if (opt.bars) opt.labels.forEach((_, i) => {
    let acc = 0;
    for (const b of opt.bars) {
      const v = b.values[i] || 0; if (v <= 0) continue;
      const y1 = Y(acc + v), y0 = Y(acc); acc += v;
      s.push(`<rect x="${f1(X(i) - bw * 0.34)}" width="${f1(bw * 0.68)}" y="${f1(y1)}" height="${f1(Math.max(0.5, y0 - y1))}" fill="${b.color}" rx="1.5"/>`);
    }
  });
  if (opt.barLine) opt.barLine.values.forEach((v, i) => { if (v) s.push(`<line x1="${f1(X(i) - bw * 0.45)}" x2="${f1(X(i) + bw * 0.45)}" y1="${f1(Y(v))}" y2="${f1(Y(v))}" stroke="${opt.barLine.color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>`); });
  if (opt.refLine) s.push(`<line x1="${PL}" x2="${W - PR}" y1="${f1(Y(opt.refLine.y))}" y2="${f1(Y(opt.refLine.y))}" stroke="${opt.refLine.color}" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>`);
  // lines (null breaks the line)
  for (const l of opt.lines || []) {
    let d = '', pen = false;
    l.values.forEach((v, i) => { if (v == null) { pen = false; return; } d += `${pen ? 'L' : 'M'}${f1(X(i))} ${f1(Y(v))}`; pen = true; });
    if (d) s.push(`<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${l.color}" stroke-width="${l.width || 2}" ${l.dash ? `stroke-dasharray="${l.dash}"` : ''} stroke-linejoin="round"/>`);
    if (l.dots) l.values.forEach((v, i) => { if (v != null) s.push(`<circle cx="${f1(X(i))}" cy="${f1(Y(v))}" r="2.5" fill="${l.color}"/>`); });
  }
  for (const d of opt.dots || []) s.push(`<circle cx="${f1(X(d.i))}" cy="${f1(Y(d.y))}" r="3" fill="${d.color}" opacity=".85"/>`);
  // x labels: at most ~7
  const step = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(n / 7));
  opt.labels.forEach((t, i) => { if ((n - 1 - i) % step === 0) s.push(`<text x="${f1(X(i))}" y="${H - 6}" class="xl">${t}</text>`); });
  s.push('</svg>');
  return s.join('');
}

export const legend = items => `<div class="legend">${items.map(([c, t, dash]) => `<span><i style="background:${dash ? 'none' : c};border-top:${dash ? `2px dashed ${c}` : 'none'}"></i>${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;
#@END path=js/charts.js
#@FILE path=js/db.js enc=utf8 bytes=2408 sha256=140f7ffe0ecb2c1a8332a32cc523a9547a4938b0efe412c8ba0e727c22210779
// Minimal IndexedDB wrapper (no external library). v2: activities, v3: checkins.
const NAME = 'fitplan', VER = 3;
const STORES = { meta: 'key', plans: 'plan_version', sessions: 'id', races: 'id', logs: 'id', activities: 'id', checkins: 'date' };
let dbp;
function open() {
  if (dbp) return dbp;
  dbp = new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const r = indexedDB.open(NAME, VER);
    r.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      for (const [s, k] of Object.entries(STORES))
        if (!r.result.objectStoreNames.contains(s)) r.result.createObjectStore(s, { keyPath: k });
    };
    r.onsuccess = () => res(r.result);
    r.onerror = () => rej(r.error);
  });
  return dbp;
}
const done = tx => new Promise((res, rej) => { tx.oncomplete = res; tx.onerror = tx.onabort = () => rej(tx.error); });
const req = r => new Promise((res, rej) => { r.onsuccess = () => res(r.result); r.onerror = () => rej(r.error); });

export async function all(store) { const db = await open(); return req(db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).getAll()); }
export async function get(store, key) { const db = await open(); return req(db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).get(key)); }
export async function put(store, val) { const db = await open(); const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite'); tx.objectStore(store).put(val); return done(tx); }
export async function getMeta(key, dflt) { const r = await get('meta', key); return r ? r.value : dflt; }
export const setMeta = (key, value) => put('meta', { key, value });

// Atomic multi-store write: ops = [{store, put?:obj, del?:key, clear?:true}]
export async function batch(ops) {
  if (!ops.length) return;
  const db = await open();
  const stores = [...new Set(ops.map(o => o.store))];
  const tx = db.transaction(stores, 'readwrite');
  for (const o of ops) {
    const s = tx.objectStore(o.store);
    if (o.clear) s.clear(); else if (o.del !== undefined) s.delete(o.del); else s.put(o.put);
  }
  return done(tx);
}
export async function dump() {
  const out = {};
  for (const s of Object.keys(STORES)) out[s] = await all(s);
  return out;
}
export async function restore(data) {
  const ops = [];
  for (const s of Object.keys(STORES)) {
    ops.push({ store: s, clear: true });
    for (const v of data[s] || []) ops.push({ store: s, put: v });
  }
  return batch(ops);
}
export async function wipe() { return batch(Object.keys(STORES).map(s => ({ store: s, clear: true }))); }
#@END path=js/db.js
#@FILE path=js/fit.js enc=utf8 bytes=3242 sha256=7c4c4d34b526c362bd854e91e66a35c2b464f7e3b9ec9bd5011883e71504d1b0
// Minimal FIT decoder (Garmin FIT protocol). Reads definition/data messages,
// compressed timestamps and developer fields (skipped). Returns {globalMsgNum: [ {fieldNum: value} ]}.
export const FIT_EPOCH = 631065600; // seconds between 1970-01-01 and 1989-12-31 UTC

const BT = { 0x00: 'u8', 0x01: 'i8', 0x02: 'u8', 0x83: 'i16', 0x84: 'u16', 0x85: 'i32', 0x86: 'u32', 0x07: 'str',
  0x88: 'f32', 0x89: 'f64', 0x0A: 'u8z', 0x8B: 'u16z', 0x8C: 'u32z', 0x0D: 'byte', 0x8E: 'i64', 0x8F: 'u64', 0x90: 'u64z' };
const SIZE = { u8: 1, i8: 1, u8z: 1, byte: 1, u16: 2, i16: 2, u16z: 2, u32: 4, i32: 4, u32z: 4, f32: 4, f64: 8, i64: 8, u64: 8, u64z: 8, str: 1 };
const INVALID = { u8: 0xFF, i8: 0x7F, u16: 0xFFFF, i16: 0x7FFF, u32: 0xFFFFFFFF, i32: 0x7FFFFFFF, u8z: 0, u16z: 0, u32z: 0, byte: 0xFF };

export function isFit(buf) {
  const b = new Uint8Array(buf);
  return b.length > 14 && String.fromCharCode(b[8], b[9], b[10], b[11]) === '.FIT';
}

function read(dv, o, t, le) {
  switch (t) {
    case 'u8': case 'u8z': case 'byte': return dv.getUint8(o);
    case 'i8': return dv.getInt8(o);
    case 'u16': case 'u16z': return dv.getUint16(o, le);
    case 'i16': return dv.getInt16(o, le);
    case 'u32': case 'u32z': return dv.getUint32(o, le);
    case 'i32': return dv.getInt32(o, le);
    case 'f32': return dv.getFloat32(o, le);
    case 'f64': return dv.getFloat64(o, le);
    default: return null; // 64-bit ints not needed
  }
}

export function decode(buf) {
  if (!isFit(buf)) throw new Error('Not a FIT file');
  const dv = new DataView(buf);
  const hs = dv.getUint8(0), size = dv.getUint32(4, true);
  const end = Math.min(hs + size, buf.byteLength);
  const defs = {}, out = {};
  let i = hs, lastTs = 0;
  while (i < end) {
    const h = dv.getUint8(i++);
    let def, off = null;
    if (h & 0x80) { def = defs[(h >> 5) & 3]; off = h & 0x1f; }           // compressed timestamp header
    else if (h & 0x40) {                                                      // definition message
      const le = dv.getUint8(i + 1) === 0, gm = dv.getUint16(i + 2, le), n = dv.getUint8(i + 4); i += 5;
      const fields = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++, i += 3) fields.push([dv.getUint8(i), dv.getUint8(i + 1), dv.getUint8(i + 2)]);
      let dev = 0;
      if (h & 0x20) { const nd = dv.getUint8(i++); for (let k = 0; k < nd; k++, i += 3) dev += dv.getUint8(i + 1); }
      defs[h & 0x0f] = { le, gm, fields, dev };
      continue;
    } else def = defs[h & 0x0f];
    if (!def) throw new Error('Corrupt FIT: data before definition');
    const rec = {};
    for (const [num, sz, bt] of def.fields) {
      const t = BT[bt] || 'byte';
      if (t === 'str') {
        let s = ''; for (let k = 0; k < sz; k++) { const c = dv.getUint8(i + k); if (!c) break; s += String.fromCharCode(c); }
        rec[num] = s;
      } else if (sz === SIZE[t]) {
        const v = read(dv, i, t, def.le);
        rec[num] = v === INVALID[t] ? null : v;
      } // arrays ignored (not needed)
      i += sz;
    }
    i += def.dev;
    if (off !== null) { let ts = lastTs - (lastTs & 0x1f) + off; if (off < (lastTs & 0x1f)) ts += 32; rec[253] = ts; }
    if (rec[253] != null) lastTs = rec[253];
    (out[def.gm] ||= []).push(rec);
  }
  return out;
}
#@END path=js/fit.js
#@FILE path=js/match.js enc=utf8 bytes=3272 sha256=7d5487c3f11826d7466cc43ef6aa244557bab86d4df889daa4cf8b31a7c8f5c4
// Activity ↔ planned session matching and status proposal (pure functions).

// Compatible planned session types per activity type, in order of preference.
export const COMPAT = {
  run: ['run', 'race', 'ocr'], bike: ['bike'], strength: ['strength', 'ocr', 'mobility'],
  walk: ['mobility', 'race', 'other'], hike: ['run', 'race', 'other'], swim: ['other'],
  other: ['other', 'ocr', 'race', 'mobility', 'strength']
};
const compat = t => COMPAT[t] || COMPAT.other;

export const isDuplicate = (a, list) => list.some(b => b.type === a.type && Math.abs(b.start_ts - a.start_ts) <= 60);

/** dayActs: all activities of one date; daySessions: planned sessions that date.
 *  Manual assignments are kept. Returns {actId: {session_id, role}}. */
export function autoAssign(dayActs, daySessions) {
  const plan = daySessions.filter(s => s.type !== 'rest');
  const acts = [...dayActs].sort((a, b) => a.start_ts - b.start_ts);
  const res = {}, used = new Set();
  for (const a of acts) if (a.manual) { res[a.id] = { session_id: a.session_id, role: a.role }; if (a.session_id) used.add(a.session_id); }
  for (const a of acts) {
    if (a.manual) continue;
    const pref = compat(a.type), c = plan.filter(s => pref.includes(s.type));
    if (!c.length) { res[a.id] = { session_id: null, role: null }; continue; }
    c.sort((x, y) => (used.has(x.id) - used.has(y.id)) || (pref.indexOf(x.type) - pref.indexOf(y.type)) ||
      (Math.abs((x.duration_min || 0) - a.moving_min) - Math.abs((y.duration_min || 0) - a.moving_min)));
    res[a.id] = { session_id: c[0].id, role: null }; used.add(c[0].id);
  }
  // Warm-up rule: short run (< 15 min) directly followed (≤ 30 min) by an activity on a strength/OCR session.
  acts.forEach((a, k) => {
    if (a.manual || a.type !== 'run' || a.moving_min >= 15) return;
    const nx = acts[k + 1]; if (!nx || nx.start_ts - a.end_ts > 1800) return;
    const ns = plan.find(s => s.id === res[nx.id]?.session_id);
    if (!ns || !['strength', 'ocr', 'mobility'].includes(ns.type)) return;
    const own = plan.find(s => s.id === res[a.id].session_id);
    if (!own || (own.duration_min || 0) >= 2 * a.moving_min) res[a.id] = { session_id: ns.id, role: 'warmup' };
  });
  return res;
}

/** Proposed status for a session from its linked activities. */
export function proposeStatus(session, acts) {
  if (!acts.length) return null;
  const moving = acts.reduce((t, a) => t + a.moving_min, 0), planned = session.duration_min || 0;
  const durOk = !planned || moving >= 0.8 * planned;
  const zs = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  acts.filter(a => a.role !== 'warmup').forEach(a => a.zone_min.forEach((z, i) => zs[i] += z));
  const tot = zs.reduce((t, z) => t + z, 0), tz = session.target?.hr_zone;
  let zoneOk = true, zoneTxt = '';
  if (tz && tot > 0) {
    if (tz <= 2) { const above = zs.slice(tz).reduce((t, z) => t + z, 0) / tot; zoneOk = above <= 0.2; zoneTxt = `${Math.round(above * 100)}% above Z${tz}`; }
    else { const at = zs.slice(tz - 1).reduce((t, z) => t + z, 0) / tot; zoneOk = at >= 0.15; zoneTxt = `${Math.round(at * 100)}% in Z${tz}+`; }
  }
  const reason = [`${Math.round(moving)}${planned ? '/' + planned : ''} min`, zoneTxt].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return { status: durOk && zoneOk ? 'done' : 'modified', reason };
}
#@END path=js/match.js
#@FILE path=js/metrics.js enc=utf8 bytes=4368 sha256=f2401df014d774a6c8e799f31aca56a338bf91d5ca3495d361fb809821b9e57e
// Turns decoded FIT messages into a compact activity summary (raw records are discarded).
import { FIT_EPOCH } from './fit.js';
import { iso } from './util.js';

const SPORT = { 1: 'run', 2: 'bike', 4: 'strength', 10: 'strength', 11: 'walk', 17: 'hike', 5: 'swim' };
const SUB = { 1: 'treadmill', 2: 'street', 3: 'trail', 6: 'indoor', 20: 'strength', 26: 'cardio' };
const toDate = ts => new Date((ts + FIT_EPOCH) * 1000);
const r1 = x => Math.round(x * 10) / 10;

export const zoneOf = (hr, Z) => hr <= Z[0] ? 0 : hr <= Z[1] ? 1 : hr <= Z[2] ? 2 : hr <= Z[3] ? 3 : 4;

export function summarize(m, athlete, fileName = '') {
  const s = (m[18] || [])[0];
  if (!s) throw new Error('No session data in file');
  const start = s[2] ?? m[0]?.[0]?.[4];
  const recs = (m[20] || []).filter(r => r[253] != null).sort((a, b) => a[253] - b[253]);
  const type = SPORT[s[5]] || 'other';
  const end = s[253] ?? (start + Math.round((s[7] || 0) / 1000));

  // Timer pauses: stop (event_type 1/4) … start (0) of timer events (event 0)
  const pauses = []; let stopAt = null;
  for (const e of (m[21] || []).filter(e => e[0] === 0).sort((a, b) => a[253] - b[253])) {
    if (e[1] === 1 || e[1] === 4) stopAt ??= e[253];
    else if (e[1] === 0 && stopAt != null) { pauses.push([stopAt, e[253]]); stopAt = null; }
  }
  const paused = t => pauses.some(([a, b]) => t >= a && t < b);

  // Time in zone (time-weighted, Δt capped at 30 s, pauses excluded) + Banister TRIMP
  const Z = athlete.zones, hrr = hr => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (hr - athlete.hr_rest) / (athlete.hr_max - athlete.hr_rest)));
  const zs = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]; let trimp = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < recs.length; k++) {
    const r = recs[k], hr = r[3];
    if (hr == null || paused(r[253])) continue;
    const dt = Math.min(30, k + 1 < recs.length ? recs[k + 1][253] - r[253] : 1);
    if (dt <= 0) continue;
    zs[zoneOf(hr, Z)] += dt;
    const x = hrr(hr); trimp += dt / 60 * x * 0.64 * Math.exp(1.92 * x);
  }

  // 30 s bins → HR/speed series and aerobic marker (pace at HR Z1+3 … Z2 upper, flat, ≥ 5 min)
  const bins = new Map();
  for (const r of recs) {
    if (paused(r[253])) continue;
    const b = Math.floor((r[253] - start) / 30);
    const o = bins.get(b) || { hr: [], d0: null, d1: null, a0: null, a1: null };
    if (r[3] != null) o.hr.push(r[3]);
    const dist = r[5] != null ? r[5] / 100 : null, alt = r[78] != null ? r[78] / 5 - 500 : r[2] != null ? r[2] / 5 - 500 : null;
    if (dist != null) { o.d0 ??= dist; o.d1 = dist; }
    if (alt != null) { o.a0 ??= alt; o.a1 = alt; }
    bins.set(b, o);
  }
  const hr30 = [], spd30 = [], easy = [];
  for (const [, o] of [...bins].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])) {
    const h = o.hr.length ? o.hr.reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0) / o.hr.length : null;
    const dd = o.d1 != null ? o.d1 - o.d0 : null, v = dd != null ? dd / 30 : null;
    hr30.push(h ? Math.round(h) : null); spd30.push(v != null ? Math.round(v * 100) / 100 : null);
    const flat = o.a0 == null || dd < 20 || Math.abs(o.a1 - o.a0) / dd <= 0.01;
    if (type === 'run' && h >= Z[0] + 3 && h <= Z[1] && v > 1.5 && flat) easy.push(v);
  }
  easy.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const easyPace = easy.length >= 10 ? 1000 / 60 / easy[Math.floor(easy.length / 2)] : null;

  const dist = s[9] ? s[9] / 1e5 : 0, moving = (s[8] ?? s[7] ?? 0) / 60000;
  const startD = toDate(start);
  return {
    id: `a-${start}`, start: startD.toISOString(), start_ts: start, end_ts: end, date: iso(startD),
    type, subtype: SUB[s[6]] || null, file: fileName,
    elapsed_min: r1((s[7] || 0) / 60000), moving_min: r1(moving),
    distance_km: dist ? Math.round(dist * 100) / 100 : null,
    pace_min_km: type === 'run' && dist > 0.2 ? Math.round(moving / dist * 100) / 100 : null,
    avg_hr: s[16] ?? null, max_hr: s[17] ?? null, ascent_m: s[22] ?? null,
    cadence_spm: type === 'run' && s[18] ? s[18] * 2 : null, kcal: s[11] ?? null,
    has_gps: recs.some(r => r[0] != null),
    zone_min: zs.map(x => r1(x / 60)), trimp: Math.round(trimp),
    easy_pace_min_km: easyPace ? Math.round(easyPace * 100) / 100 : null,
    laps: (m[19] || []).map(l => ({ min: r1((l[8] ?? l[7] ?? 0) / 60000), km: l[9] ? Math.round(l[9] / 1000) / 100 : null, avg_hr: l[15] ?? null, max_hr: l[16] ?? null })),
    hr30, spd30,
    session_id: null, role: null, manual: false, imported_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}
#@END path=js/metrics.js
#@FILE path=js/plan.js enc=utf8 bytes=3170 sha256=5c4e980dcb456520ce64297d6cd3dd0bfb5f6a23481de76a691e51e35f322934
// Plan schema validation and merge logic (pure functions, testable in Node).
import { isISODate } from './util.js';

export const SCHEMA = 'fitplan.plan/1.0';
export const TYPES = ['run', 'bike', 'strength', 'ocr', 'mobility', 'rest', 'race', 'other'];

export function validatePlan(p) {
  const e = [];
  if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return ['File is not a JSON object'];
  if (p.schema !== SCHEMA) e.push(`schema must be "${SCHEMA}" (found "${p.schema}")`);
  if (!Number.isInteger(p.plan_version) || p.plan_version < 1) e.push('plan_version must be an integer ≥ 1');
  if (!isISODate(p.valid_from)) e.push('valid_from must be a date yyyy-mm-dd');
  if (!Array.isArray(p.sessions)) e.push('sessions must be an array');
  if (p.athlete?.zones && !(Array.isArray(p.athlete.zones) && p.athlete.zones.length === 4 && p.athlete.zones.every((z, i, a) => Number.isFinite(z) && (i === 0 || z > a[i - 1]))))
    e.push('athlete.zones must be 4 ascending upper limits, e.g. [117,130,142,154]');
  (p.races || []).forEach((r, i) => {
    if (!r.id) e.push(`races[${i}]: id missing`);
    if (!isISODate(r.date)) e.push(`races[${i}] ${r.id || ''}: date invalid`);
    if (!r.name) e.push(`races[${i}] ${r.id || ''}: name missing`);
  });
  const ids = new Set();
  (p.sessions || []).forEach((s, i) => {
    const tag = `sessions[${i}] ${s.id || ''}`;
    if (!s.id) e.push(`${tag}: id missing`);
    else if (ids.has(s.id)) e.push(`${tag}: duplicate id`); else ids.add(s.id);
    if (!isISODate(s.date)) e.push(`${tag}: date invalid`);
    else if (isISODate(p.valid_from) && s.date < p.valid_from) e.push(`${tag}: date before valid_from`);
    if (!TYPES.includes(s.type)) e.push(`${tag}: type must be one of ${TYPES.join('|')}`);
    if (!s.title) e.push(`${tag}: title missing`);
    if (s.blocks && !Array.isArray(s.blocks)) e.push(`${tag}: blocks must be an array`);
  });
  return e;
}

// Locked = user set a status manually (auto-proposed statuses from FIT import do not lock).
const locked = (logs, id) => { const l = logs[id]; return !!l && l.status && l.status !== 'pending' && !l.auto; };
const sig = s => JSON.stringify({ ...s, plan_version: undefined });

/** current: stored sessions; logs: {id: log}; plan: validated plan. Returns diff + resulting sessions. */
export function mergePlan(current, logs, plan) {
  const vf = plan.valid_from;
  const incoming = new Map(plan.sessions.map(s => [s.id, { ...s, slot: s.slot ?? 1, plan_version: plan.plan_version }]));
  const result = [], added = [], changed = [], removed = [], kept = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const s of current) {
    if (s.date < vf || locked(logs, s.id)) {
      result.push(s); seen.add(s.id);
      if (incoming.has(s.id) && s.date >= vf) kept.push(s);
      continue;
    }
    if (incoming.has(s.id)) {
      const n = incoming.get(s.id); result.push(n); seen.add(s.id);
      if (sig(n) !== sig(s)) changed.push(n);
    } else removed.push(s);
  }
  for (const [id, n] of incoming) if (!seen.has(id)) { result.push(n); added.push(n); }
  result.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.slot - b.slot);
  return { added, changed, removed, kept, sessions: result };
}
#@END path=js/plan.js
#@FILE path=js/progress.js enc=utf8 bytes=10571 sha256=af1546cf80e80279862146202237c06f70635c90e9b4c70c1e31b86e60d414ad
// Progress report for Copilot: fitplan.progress/1.0 (JSON) + compact Markdown. Pure functions.
import { addDays, daysBetween, mondayOf, isoWeek, fmt, fmtShort, fmtPace, r1 } from './util.js';

export const PSCHEMA = 'fitplan.progress/1.0';
export const PAIN_LOCS = { r_foot: 'R foot/heel', l_foot: 'L foot/heel', r_calf: 'R calf', l_calf: 'L calf', r_knee: 'R knee', l_knee: 'L knee',
  r_hip: 'R hip', l_hip: 'L hip', low_back: 'Low back', shoulder: 'Shoulder', hand: 'Hand/grip', other: 'Other' };

const sum = (a, f) => a.reduce((t, x) => t + (f(x) || 0), 0);
const median = a => { const s = a.filter(x => x != null).sort((x, y) => x - y); return s.length ? s[Math.floor(s.length / 2)] : null; };
const addZ = acts => acts.reduce((z, a) => z.map((v, i) => r1(v + (a.zone_min?.[i] || 0))), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
const avg = a => { const v = a.filter(x => x != null); return v.length ? r1(v.reduce((t, x) => t + x, 0) / v.length) : null; };

function actual(acts) {
  if (!acts.length) return null;
  const mov = sum(acts, a => a.moving_min), km = sum(acts, a => a.distance_km), runs = acts.filter(a => a.type === 'run');
  const runMov = sum(runs, a => a.moving_min), runKm = sum(runs, a => a.distance_km);
  const hrW = acts.filter(a => a.avg_hr), hrMov = sum(hrW, a => a.moving_min);
  return {
    activities: acts.map(a => ({ start: a.start, type: a.type, subtype: a.subtype, role: a.role || 'main', moving_min: a.moving_min })),
    moving_min: r1(mov), distance_km: km ? r1(km) : null,
    pace_min_km: runKm > 0.2 ? fmtPace(runMov / runKm) : null,
    avg_hr: hrMov ? Math.round(sum(hrW, a => a.avg_hr * a.moving_min) / hrMov) : null,
    max_hr: Math.max(0, ...acts.map(a => a.max_hr || 0)) || null,
    ascent_m: sum(acts, a => a.ascent_m) || null,
    zone_min: addZ(acts), trimp: sum(acts, a => a.trimp)
  };
}

/** Pain flags: any score ≥ 3, or same location ≥ 1 on 5+ consecutive check-in days. */
export function painFlags(checkins) {
  const flags = [], byLoc = {};
  for (const c of [...checkins].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)))
    for (const p of c.pain || []) {
      if (p.score >= 3) flags.push(`${fmt(c.date)}: ${PAIN_LOCS[p.loc] || p.loc} pain ${p.score}/10`);
      if (p.score >= 1) (byLoc[p.loc] ||= []).push(c.date);
    }
  for (const [loc, ds] of Object.entries(byLoc)) {
    let run = 1, best = 1, bestEnd = ds[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < ds.length; i++) { run = daysBetween(ds[i - 1], ds[i]) === 1 ? run + 1 : 1; if (run > best) { best = run; bestEnd = ds[i]; } }
    if (best >= 5) flags.push(`${PAIN_LOCS[loc] || loc}: pain on ${best} consecutive days (until ${fmt(bestEnd)})`);
  }
  return flags;
}

/** ACWR (TRIMP): acute 7-day load ÷ chronic 28-day weekly average, ending at `to`. */
export function loadRatio(allActs, to) {
  const inRange = (a, d) => a.date > addDays(to, -d) && a.date <= to;
  const acute = sum(allActs.filter(a => inRange(a, 7)), a => a.trimp), chronic = sum(allActs.filter(a => inRange(a, 28)), a => a.trimp) / 4;
  const first = allActs.filter(a => a.date <= to).map(a => a.date).sort()[0];
  const hist = first ? daysBetween(first, to) + 1 : 0;           // ACWR needs 28 days of history to be meaningful
  return { acute_7d: acute, chronic_28d_weekly: Math.round(chronic), history_days: hist,
    acwr: chronic && hist >= 28 ? Math.round(acute / chronic * 100) / 100 : null };
}

export function buildProgress({ from, to, todayStr, sessions, logs, acts, checkins, races, plan, athlete, appVersion }) {
  const inWin = d => d >= from && d <= to;
  const ci = Object.fromEntries(checkins.filter(c => inWin(c.date)).map(c => [c.date, c]));
  const days = [];
  for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) {
    const ss = sessions.filter(s => s.date === d).map(s => {
      const log = logs[s.id] || {}, a = acts.filter(x => x.session_id === s.id);
      let status = log.status || 'pending';
      if (s.type === 'rest' && status === 'pending') status = 'rest';
      else if (status === 'pending' && d < todayStr) status = 'missed';
      return { plan_id: s.id, title: s.title, status, status_source: log.status && log.status !== 'pending' ? (log.auto ? 'auto' : 'user') : null,
        planned: { type: s.type, subtype: s.subtype || null, duration_min: s.duration_min || null, distance_km: s.distance_km || null, hr_zone: s.target?.hr_zone || null },
        actual: actual(a), user_note: log.note || null };
    });
    const extras = acts.filter(a => a.date === d && !a.session_id).map(a => ({ type: a.type, subtype: a.subtype, ...actual([a]) }));
    const c = ci[d];
    if (ss.length || extras.length || c) days.push({ date: d, sessions: ss, extras, checkin: c ? { rpe: c.rpe ?? null, sleep_h: c.sleep_h ?? null, energy: c.energy ?? null, rhr: c.rhr ?? null, pain: c.pain || [], note: c.note || null } : null });
  }
  const weeks = [];
  for (let ws = mondayOf(from); ws <= to; ws = addDays(ws, 7)) {
    const a = ws < from ? from : ws, b = addDays(ws, 6) > to ? to : addDays(ws, 6), w = d => d >= a && d <= b;
    const wa = acts.filter(x => w(x.date)), runs = wa.filter(x => x.type === 'run');
    const ps = sessions.filter(s => w(s.date) && s.type !== 'rest'), planned = sum(ps, s => s.duration_min);
    const dn = sum(ps.filter(s => ['done', 'modified'].includes(logs[s.id]?.status)), s => s.duration_min);
    const wc = checkins.filter(c => w(c.date));
    weeks.push({ week: isoWeek(ws), from: a, to: b, partial: a !== ws || b !== addDays(ws, 6),
      sessions_planned: ps.length, sessions_done: ps.filter(s => ['done', 'modified'].includes(logs[s.id]?.status)).length,
      planned_min: planned, compliance_pct: planned ? Math.round(100 * dn / planned) : null,
      moving_h: r1(sum(wa, x => x.moving_min) / 60), run_km: r1(sum(runs, x => x.distance_km)), ascent_m: sum(wa, x => x.ascent_m),
      zone_min: addZ(wa), trimp: sum(wa, x => x.trimp),
      easy_pace_min_km: fmtPace(median(runs.map(x => x.easy_pace_min_km))) || null,
      avg_rpe: avg(wc.map(c => c.rpe)), avg_sleep_h: avg(wc.map(c => c.sleep_h)), avg_rhr: avg(wc.map(c => c.rhr)),
      max_pain: wc.length ? Math.max(0, ...wc.flatMap(c => (c.pain || []).map(p => p.score))) : null });
  }
  const winSessions = days.flatMap(d => d.sessions);
  return {
    schema: PSCHEMA, generated_at: new Date().toISOString(), app_version: appVersion,
    plan_version: plan?.plan_version ?? null, window: { from, to, days: daysBetween(from, to) + 1 },
    athlete,
    next_races: races.filter(r => r.date >= to).slice(0, 5).map(r => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, date: r.date, days_to_go: daysBetween(to, r.date), priority: r.priority || null })),
    summary: {
      sessions_planned: winSessions.filter(s => s.planned.type !== 'rest').length,
      done: winSessions.filter(s => s.status === 'done').length, modified: winSessions.filter(s => s.status === 'modified').length,
      skipped: winSessions.filter(s => s.status === 'skipped').length, missed: winSessions.filter(s => s.status === 'missed').length,
      checkin_days: Object.keys(ci).length, load: loadRatio(acts, to), flags: painFlags(Object.values(ci))
    },
    weeks, days
  };
}

const zTxt = z => z.map(v => Math.round(v)).join('/');
export function toMarkdown(p) {
  const L = [], s = p.summary;
  L.push(`# FitPlan progress ${fmt(p.window.from)} – ${fmt(p.window.to)} (${p.window.days} days)`);
  L.push(`Plan v${p.plan_version ?? '-'} · HRmax ${p.athlete.hr_max} · HRrest ${p.athlete.hr_rest} · Zones Z1≤${p.athlete.zones[0]}, Z2≤${p.athlete.zones[1]}, Z3≤${p.athlete.zones[2]}, Z4≤${p.athlete.zones[3]}, Z5>${p.athlete.zones[3]}`);
  if (p.next_races.length) L.push(`Next races: ${p.next_races.slice(0, 3).map(r => `${r.name} ${fmt(r.date)} (${r.days_to_go} d)`).join('; ')}`);
  L.push('', '## Summary');
  L.push(`Sessions: ${s.sessions_planned} planned · ${s.done} done · ${s.modified} modified · ${s.skipped} skipped · ${s.missed} missed · check-ins ${s.checkin_days}/${p.window.days}`);
  L.push(`Load (TRIMP): last 7 d ${s.load.acute_7d} · 28-d weekly avg ${s.load.chronic_28d_weekly} · ACWR ${s.load.acwr ?? `n/a (${s.load.history_days} d history, needs 28)`}`);
  L.push(`Flags: ${s.flags.length ? s.flags.join('; ') : 'none'}`);
  L.push('', '## Weeks', '| Week | Compl. | Hours | Run km | D+ | TRIMP | Zone min Z1–Z5 | Easy pace | RPE | Sleep h | RHR | Max pain |', '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|');
  for (const w of p.weeks) L.push(`| ${w.week}${w.partial ? '*' : ''} | ${w.compliance_pct ?? '-'}% | ${w.moving_h} | ${w.run_km} | ${w.ascent_m} | ${w.trimp} | ${zTxt(w.zone_min)} | ${w.easy_pace_min_km ?? '-'} | ${w.avg_rpe ?? '-'} | ${w.avg_sleep_h ?? '-'} | ${w.avg_rhr ?? '-'} | ${w.max_pain ?? '-'} |`);
  if (p.weeks.some(w => w.partial)) L.push('*partial week');
  L.push('', '## Days');
  const act = a => a ? [`${Math.round(a.moving_min)}′`, a.distance_km && `${a.distance_km} km`, a.pace_min_km && `${a.pace_min_km}/km`, a.avg_hr && `HR ${a.avg_hr}/${a.max_hr}`, a.ascent_m && `D+ ${a.ascent_m}`, `Z ${zTxt(a.zone_min)}`, `TRIMP ${a.trimp}`].filter(Boolean).join(', ') : '';
  for (const d of p.days) {
    const parts = [];
    for (const x of d.sessions) parts.push(x.planned.type === 'rest' && !x.actual ? `${x.title} → ${x.status}${x.user_note ? ` – "${x.user_note}"` : ''}` : `${x.title} [${x.planned.duration_min ?? '-'}′${x.planned.hr_zone ? ' Z' + x.planned.hr_zone : ''}] → ${x.status}${x.actual ? ': ' + act(x.actual) : ''}${x.user_note ? ` – "${x.user_note}"` : ''}`);
    for (const e of d.extras) parts.push(`EXTRA ${e.type}: ${act(e)}`);
    const c = d.checkin;
    if (c) parts.push(`Check-in: ${[c.rpe != null && `RPE ${c.rpe}`, c.sleep_h != null && `sleep ${c.sleep_h} h`, c.energy != null && `energy ${c.energy}/5`, c.rhr && `RHR ${c.rhr}`,
      c.pain.length ? 'pain ' + c.pain.map(x => `${PAIN_LOCS[x.loc] || x.loc} ${x.score}`).join(', ') : 'no pain', c.note && `"${c.note}"`].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}`);
    L.push(`- **${fmtShort(d.date)}**: ${parts.join(' | ')}`);
  }
  return L.join('\n');
}

export const ASSESS_PROMPT = `Assess my progress using this FitPlan progress report (schema fitplan.progress/1.0).
Report: (1) compliance & load trend vs. plan, (2) aerobic marker (easy pace at Z2 HR), (3) intensity distribution vs. target,
(4) pain/recovery flags, (5) readiness for the next race. Then tell me if the plan needs changes; if yes, output an updated
plan as ONE JSON code block in schema fitplan.plan/1.0 (plan_version = current + 1, valid_from = first changed date,
only sessions from valid_from onward, keep race IDs).`;
#@END path=js/progress.js
#@FILE path=js/trends.js enc=utf8 bytes=4432 sha256=b6944d8d31586b244f325a9fbf3ac8db80d7b4b0068ec49466c63a718e134e7c
// Trend series for the Trends tab (pure functions, testable in Node).
import { addDays, daysBetween, mondayOf, isoWeek, r1 } from './util.js';

const sum = (a, f) => a.reduce((t, x) => t + (f(x) || 0), 0);
const median = a => { const s = a.filter(x => x != null).sort((x, y) => x - y); if (!s.length) return null; const m = s.length >> 1; return s.length % 2 ? s[m] : (s[m - 1] + s[m]) / 2; };
const avg = a => { const v = a.filter(x => x != null); return v.length ? v.reduce((t, x) => t + x, 0) / v.length : null; };
const DONE = ['done', 'modified'];

/** Weekly aggregates for nWeeks ending with the week containing `to`. */
export function weeklySeries({ acts, sessions, logs, checkins, to, nWeeks }) {
  const last = mondayOf(to), out = [];
  for (let k = nWeeks - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
    const ws = addDays(last, -7 * k), we = addDays(ws, 6), w = d => d >= ws && d <= we;
    const wa = acts.filter(a => w(a.date)), runs = wa.filter(a => a.type === 'run');
    const ps = sessions.filter(s => w(s.date) && s.type !== 'rest'), planned = sum(ps, s => s.duration_min);
    const done = sum(ps.filter(s => DONE.includes(logs[s.id]?.status)), s => s.duration_min);
    const wc = checkins.filter(c => w(c.date));
    const zone_h = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => sum(wa, a => a.zone_min?.[i]) / 60);
    out.push({
      ws, week: isoWeek(ws), current: ws === last,
      hours: sum(wa, a => a.moving_min) / 60, zone_h, planned_h: planned / 60,
      compliance: planned ? Math.round(100 * done / planned) : null,
      run_km: sum(runs, a => a.distance_km), ascent_m: sum(wa, a => a.ascent_m), trimp: sum(wa, a => a.trimp),
      easy_pace: median(runs.map(a => a.easy_pace_min_km)),
      max_pain: wc.length ? Math.max(0, ...wc.flatMap(c => (c.pain || []).map(p => p.score))) : null,
      rhr: avg(wc.map(c => c.rhr)), sleep_h: avg(wc.map(c => c.sleep_h))
    });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Daily load: acute = 7-day TRIMP sum, chronic = 28-day sum ÷ 4, ACWR once ≥ 28 days of history. */
export function loadSeries({ acts, from, to }) {
  const byDay = {};
  for (const a of acts) byDay[a.date] = (byDay[a.date] || 0) + (a.trimp || 0);
  const first = acts.map(a => a.date).sort()[0];
  const out = [];
  for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) {
    let acute = 0, chronic = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 28; k++) { const v = byDay[addDays(d, -k)] || 0; chronic += v; if (k < 7) acute += v; }
    chronic /= 4;
    const hist = first && first <= d ? daysBetween(first, d) + 1 : 0;
    out.push({ date: d, trimp: byDay[d] || 0, acute, chronic: r1(chronic), acwr: hist >= 28 && chronic > 0 ? Math.round(acute / chronic * 100) / 100 : null });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Aerobic marker points (easy pace at Z2 HR on flat runs) + rolling median of the last 4 runs. */
export function easyPaceSeries({ acts, from, to }) {
  const pts = acts.filter(a => a.type === 'run' && a.easy_pace_min_km && a.date >= from && a.date <= to)
    .sort((a, b) => a.start_ts - b.start_ts).map(a => ({ date: a.date, pace: a.easy_pace_min_km }));
  pts.forEach((p, i) => { p.trend = median(pts.slice(Math.max(0, i - 3), i + 1).map(x => x.pace)); });
  return pts;
}

/** Daily wellness from check-ins. */
export function wellnessSeries({ checkins, from, to }) {
  const by = Object.fromEntries(checkins.map(c => [c.date, c])), out = [];
  for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) {
    const c = by[d];
    out.push({ date: d, pain: c ? Math.max(0, ...(c.pain || []).map(p => p.score)) : null, rhr: c?.rhr ?? null, sleep_h: c?.sleep_h ?? null });
  }
  return out;
}

/** Headline comparisons: last 4 complete weeks vs. the 4 before (current week excluded). */
export function headline(weeks, pace) {
  const full = weeks.filter(w => !w.current), a = full.slice(-4), b = full.slice(-8, -4);
  const m = (ws, f) => ws.length ? avg(ws.map(f)) : null;
  const pa = median(pace.slice(-4).map(p => p.pace)), pb = median(pace.slice(-8, -4).map(p => p.pace));
  const z = a.reduce((t, w) => t.map((v, i) => v + w.zone_h[i]), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]), zt = z.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0);
  return {
    hours: m(a, w => w.hours), hours_prev: m(b, w => w.hours),
    run_km: m(a, w => w.run_km), run_km_prev: m(b, w => w.run_km),
    compliance: m(a.filter(w => w.compliance != null), w => w.compliance),
    easy_pace: pa, easy_pace_prev: pb,
    low_pct: zt ? Math.round(100 * (z[0] + z[1]) / zt) : null    // share of time in Z1–Z2 (polarisation check)
  };
}
#@END path=js/trends.js
#@FILE path=js/util.js enc=utf8 bytes=2027 sha256=1cea0a2b80600c0b45187bcfbb1af7edbb3be3f9065b6dbb7e65c427b35ee74b
// Date & formatting helpers. Data uses ISO yyyy-mm-dd; UI shows DD-MMM-YYYY.
const MON = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
const WD = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
export const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
export const iso = d => `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
export const today = () => iso(new Date());
export const parse = s => { const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number); return new Date(y, m - 1, d, 12); };
export const addDays = (s, n) => { const d = parse(s); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return iso(d); };
export const daysBetween = (a, b) => Math.round((parse(b) - parse(a)) / 86400000);
export const fmt = s => { const d = parse(s); return `${pad(d.getDate())}-${MON[d.getMonth()]}-${d.getFullYear()}`; };
export const fmtShort = s => { const d = parse(s); return `${WD[d.getDay()]} ${pad(d.getDate())}-${MON[d.getMonth()]}`; };
export const fmtDM = s => { const d = parse(s); return `${pad(d.getDate())}-${MON[d.getMonth()]}`; };
export const mondayOf = s => { const d = parse(s); d.setDate(d.getDate() - (d.getDay() + 6) % 7); return iso(d); };
export const isoWeek = s => { const t = parse(s); t.setDate(t.getDate() + 3 - (t.getDay() + 6) % 7); const w1 = new Date(t.getFullYear(), 0, 4, 12);
  return `${t.getFullYear()}-W${pad(1 + Math.round(((t - w1) / 86400000 - 3 + (w1.getDay() + 6) % 7) / 7))}`; };
export const hhmm = isoTs => { const d = new Date(isoTs); return `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`; };
export const fmtPace = minPerKm => { if (!minPerKm) return ''; let m = Math.floor(minPerKm), s = Math.round((minPerKm - m) * 60); if (s === 60) { m++; s = 0; } return `${m}:${pad(s)}`; };
export const r1 = x => Math.round(x * 10) / 10;
export const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
export const isISODate = s => typeof s === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) && iso(parse(s)) === s;
#@END path=js/util.js

#@FILE path=sw.js enc=utf8 bytes=879 sha256=c9dac0b2b8d3cf60d98daaca040e0ebfe62ee0b1d210d09dad0fbf623998f254
// Bump VERSION on every release so the app shows the update banner.
const VERSION = 'fitplan-1.3.1';
const FILES = ['./', 'index.html', 'styles.css', 'manifest.json', 'js/app.js', 'js/db.js', 'js/plan.js', 'js/util.js',
  'js/fit.js', 'js/metrics.js', 'js/match.js', 'js/progress.js', 'js/trends.js', 'js/charts.js',
  'icons/icon-180.png', 'icons/icon-192.png', 'icons/icon-512.png'];
self.addEventListener('install', e => { self.skipWaiting(); e.waitUntil(caches.open(VERSION).then(c => c.addAll(FILES))); });
self.addEventListener('activate', e => e.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(ks => Promise.all(ks.filter(k => k !== VERSION).map(k => caches.delete(k)))).then(() => self.clients.claim())));
self.addEventListener('fetch', e => {
  if (e.request.method !== 'GET') return;
  e.respondWith(caches.match(e.request, { ignoreSearch: true }).then(r => r || fetch(e.request)));
});
#@END path=sw.js
#@FILE path=tools/bundle.py enc=utf8 bytes=6680 sha256=f459c394c1eaabeeea31d95fe0506dc43932b0afc432e28708d6ef0bf89ca8a4
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FitPlan source bundle tool (stdlib only).

  python tools/bundle.py make              -> writes fitplan-source.txt + version.json
  python tools/bundle.py verify BUNDLE     -> checks every file's SHA-256
  python tools/bundle.py unpack BUNDLE DIR -> recreates the source tree in DIR (verified)
  python tools/bundle.py selftest          -> bundle round-trip equals the working tree

Bundle format (fitplan.bundle/1), one block per file:
  #@FITPLAN-BUNDLE v1 version=<app version> commit=<git sha> files=<n>
  #@FILE path=<path> enc=<utf8|base64> bytes=<n> sha256=<hex>
  <content>
  #@END path=<path>
Text files are stored verbatim (readable), binary files as base64.
"""
import base64, hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, datetime

BUNDLE, MANIFEST = 'fitplan-source.txt', 'version.json'
EXCLUDE_FILES = {BUNDLE, MANIFEST}
EXCLUDE_DIRS = {'.git', 'node_modules', 'samples', 'data', 'backups'}
# never bundle personal training data, even if committed by mistake
EXCLUDE_RE = re.compile(r'(\.fit$|\.fit\.txt$|^fitplan-backup-.*\.json$|^progress.*\.(json|md)$|\.DS_Store$)', re.I)
TEXT_EXT = {'.html', '.css', '.js', '.mjs', '.json', '.md', '.txt', '.yml', '.yaml', '.py', '.svg', '.webmanifest', ''}
HDR = re.compile(r'^#@FILE path=(\S+) enc=(utf8|base64) bytes=(\d+) sha256=([0-9a-f]{64})$')

sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def git(*a):
    try: return subprocess.check_output(['git', *a], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).decode().strip()
    except Exception: return ''

def source_files(root='.'):
    listed = git('ls-files')
    paths = listed.splitlines() if listed else [
        os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d, f), root).replace(os.sep, '/')
        for d, ds, fs in os.walk(root) if not ds.__setitem__(slice(None), [x for x in ds if x not in EXCLUDE_DIRS]) for f in fs]
    out = []
    for p in sorted(set(paths)):
        parts = p.split('/')
        if p in EXCLUDE_FILES or EXCLUDE_DIRS & set(parts[:-1]) or EXCLUDE_RE.search(parts[-1]) or not os.path.isfile(p): continue
        out.append(p)
    return out

def is_text(path, data):
    if os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower() not in TEXT_EXT: return False
    try: data.decode('utf-8'); return b'\x00' not in data
    except UnicodeDecodeError: return False

def app_version():
    try:
        m = re.search(r"VERSION\s*=\s*'fitplan-([^']+)'", open('sw.js', encoding='utf-8').read())
        return m.group(1) if m else 'unknown'
    except OSError: return 'unknown'

def make():
    files, blocks, manifest = source_files(), [], {}
    ver, commit = app_version(), git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') or 'local'
    for p in files:
        data = open(p, 'rb').read()
        text = is_text(p, data)
        body = data.decode('utf-8') if text else base64.encodebytes(data).decode('ascii')
        if not body.endswith('\n'): body += '\n'           # block separator; exact length is in bytes=
        blocks.append(f'#@FILE path={p} enc={"utf8" if text else "base64"} bytes={len(data)} sha256={sha(data)}\n{body}#@END path={p}\n')
        manifest[p] = {'sha256': sha(data), 'bytes': len(data)}
    head = (f'#@FITPLAN-BUNDLE v1 version={ver} commit={commit} files={len(files)}\n'
            f'# Generated by tools/bundle.py. Restore with: python tools/bundle.py unpack {BUNDLE} <dir>\n')
    with open(BUNDLE, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f: f.write(head + ''.join(blocks))
    with open(MANIFEST, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        json.dump({'app': 'FitPlan', 'version': ver, 'source_commit': commit,
                   'generated_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
                   'bundle_sha256': sha(open(BUNDLE, 'rb').read()), 'files': manifest}, f, indent=2)
        f.write('\n')
    print(f'{BUNDLE}: {len(files)} files, version {ver}, commit {commit[:7]}')

def parse(bundle_path):
    raw = open(bundle_path, 'rb').read()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
    if not text.startswith('#@FITPLAN-BUNDLE v1'): raise SystemExit('Not a FitPlan bundle (missing #@FITPLAN-BUNDLE v1 header)')
    lines, i, files = text.split('\n'), 0, []
    while i < len(lines):
        m = HDR.match(lines[i].rstrip('\r'))
        if not m: i += 1; continue
        path, enc, n, h = m.group(1), m.group(2), int(m.group(3)), m.group(4)
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and lines[j].rstrip('\r') != f'#@END path={path}': j += 1
        if j == len(lines): raise SystemExit(f'Truncated bundle: no #@END for {path}')
        body = '\n'.join(lines[i + 1:j])
        if enc == 'base64': data = base64.b64decode(re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]', '', body))
        else:
            data = (body + '\n').encode('utf-8')[:n]
            if sha(data) != h:                                   # tolerate CRLF conversion during download
                alt = ('\n'.join(l[:-1] if l.endswith('\r') else l for l in body.split('\n')) + '\n').encode('utf-8')[:n]
                data = alt if sha(alt) == h else data
        files.append((path, data, h, n)); i = j + 1
    return text.split('\n', 1)[0], files

def verify(bundle_path, quiet=False):
    head, files = parse(bundle_path)
    bad = [p for p, d, h, n in files if sha(d) != h or len(d) != n]
    if not quiet:
        print(head)
        for p, d, h, n in files: print(f"{'OK ' if p not in bad else 'BAD'} {p} ({n} bytes)")
    print(f'{len(files) - len(bad)}/{len(files)} files verified' + ('' if not bad else f' – MISMATCH: {", ".join(bad)}'))
    return files, bad

def unpack(bundle_path, dest):
    files, bad = verify(bundle_path, quiet=True)
    if bad: raise SystemExit('Aborted: checksum mismatch, nothing written.')
    for p, d, h, n in files:
        if p.startswith('/') or '..' in p.split('/'): raise SystemExit(f'Unsafe path in bundle: {p}')
        out = os.path.join(dest, *p.split('/'))
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out) or '.', exist_ok=True)
        with open(out, 'wb') as f: f.write(d)
    print(f'Unpacked {len(files)} files to {dest}')

def selftest():
    files, bad = verify(BUNDLE, quiet=True)
    got, want = {p: d for p, d, h, n in files}, source_files()
    diff = [p for p in want if got.get(p) != open(p, 'rb').read()] + [p for p in got if p not in want]
    if bad or diff: raise SystemExit(f'Self-test FAILED: {", ".join(bad + diff)}')
    print(f'Self-test OK: {len(want)} files round-trip byte-exact')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    a = sys.argv[1:]
    if a[:1] == ['make']: make()
    elif a[:1] == ['verify'] and len(a) == 2: sys.exit(1 if verify(a[1])[1] else 0)
    elif a[:1] == ['unpack'] and len(a) == 3: unpack(a[1], a[2])
    elif a[:1] == ['selftest']: selftest()
    else: print(__doc__); sys.exit(2)
#@END path=tools/bundle.py
